runbook_fixes.now: `wp jetonomy notification unread-count --to=<user_id>` (the flag is --to, not --user)

`wp jetonomy mod ban --target=<id> --issuer=<id>`: a moderator (non-admin) restricting an administrator is refused 'Administrators cannot be restricted.'; anyone restricting themselves is refused 'You cannot restrict your own account.'; an administrator restricting another administrator is allowed by design

read commands: `post get <id>`, `member list-members --space=<id>`, `mod flags`, `tag popular`, `category list`, `privacy scan`, `notification list --to=<id>`, `config get` (no extra positional arg), `user get-profile <id>`
